title: Storyboard
seamIssue: Check the match with the previous shot
newShotHint: or break down the synopsis on the left
staleTip: The shot was edited after its take was generated: generate new drafts to follow the edit
editTip: Open the shot editor: prompt, duration, frames, references, drafts and engine
band.overviewTip: Sequence overview: click or drag to scroll the band
band.takesTip: The takes of each shot, the final on top: click a take or use ↑ ↓ to see it in the monitor
band.soundTip: What each shot sends to the engine as a reference sound
band.partsHint: Add markers (M) on the song to name its parts
band.noMusic: No song on a Music track
band.failedTip: Take {variant} failed: see the To check tab of the Synopsis and breakdown window
band.silentTip: No instruction: the shot would start from the global direction only
band.trimTip: Drag to change the duration; the next shots follow
band.seamIssue: Seam {n} → {m} to check: compare in the monitor
band.seamOk: Seam {n} → {m} measured: compare in the monitor
band.seamOkTip: Seam measured: compare the last and first frames in the monitor
band.seamCompare: Compare the last and first frames in the monitor
band.takeKeys: ↑ ↓ other take · Enter to use it
band.noSeam: The first shot has no seam before it
band.durationLimit: “{shot}” stays at {dur}: that is the limit of its engine or media
band.emptyText: Write the synopsis and break it down in the Synopsis and breakdown window, or add a shot. Shots take their place on the band, to the time scale, above their takes and the song.
quick.title: Shot quick edit
quick.none: Pick a shot on the band to edit it here.
quick.framesTip: Change the frames in the shot editor
story.title: Synopsis and breakdown
story.tip: Synopsis, breakdown, shots to produce and points to check
story.ghostsHint: proposed shots, dashed on the band
story.hint.phrases: Each sentence becomes a shot of 3 to 7 s, depending on its length.
story.hint.music: Shots fill the parts of the song (the markers) at the chosen average length; the sentences are spread over them in order.
story.hint.assistant: The PotionUI assistant makes a real breakdown: it names the shots and writes their prompts. Its proposal lands in this list, and every change waits for your approval.
story.noMusic: To break down on the song, place it on a Music track.
story.atStart: At the start of the sequence
story.empty: Pick a method and propose a breakdown: the shots appear here, and dashed on the band at their duration, before they are added.
story.safe: Existing shots and their takes do not change.
check.stale: “{shot}”: the prompt changed after its takes.
check.prompt: “{shot}” has no prompt: it would start from the global direction only.
check.none: Nothing to check: consistent seams, prompts written, no failed take.
